description: Generate one square white-background product image from one or two references of the same product using GPT Image 2. Submit one approved target per request. Review product identity and listing suitability before use; this endpoint does not perform reference inspection, image-set planning, or marketplace compliance certification. Generation consumes Nexscope credits.

fields.name: imageList
fields.description: Public reference image URLs of the same product. Provide up to 2 JPG, JPEG, PNG, or WEBP images; each image must be at most 10 MB and between 800 and 4096 pixels.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: Describe one target supported by the references, up to 350 characters. Output is fixed to one 1:1 image.
fields.example: Show the complete product from the supplied front view.

example.prompt: Show the complete product from the supplied front view.
